prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Meridian Regional ATFM+A-CDM; airports Meridian International(=Meridian Regional Airport), Harbor East, North Valley, Lakeside Regional, Southport. Business Rules Registry: thresholds, connection/gate/towing/stand/swap rules, border states, CTT tolerance, freeze horizon, tie-breaker permission. Modes: Normal; Adverse Weather; Capacity Reduction(binding metering; RFM may suspend swaps); Recovery; Slot Compliance; Winter(MBO confirms); Contingency Fallback(ADM declares after RFM, Tower Supervisor, SSE; role separation still enforced). Fallback: Foxglove down→Digital Briefing Room; Marlinstone/CAM unreliable→last verified Airport Capacity Plan; Blueharbor down→Slot Coordinator manual sheet at Contingency Operations Console, keeps last CTT; revised CTT needs Tower Supervisor+Ramp Control Lead, AOC readback; Ironleaf advisory; Emberline monitor-only. On restore Regional Flow Platform(RFP) reconciles contingency actions with Collaborative Decision Log(CDL), audited as same record. Connection advisory: AOC sends Passenger Misconnect Count→Airline Interface Adapter; Marlinstone sensitivity; Departure Metering Service recommends; Tower Supervisor may reject. Security: Identity Access Service(IAS) authoritative accounts/roles; no shared accounts; least privilege; temporary access needs sponsor/purpose/scope/expiry. Roles: RFM regional measures; Slot Coordinator slots, reviews substitutions post-ops for consistent priority; Tower Supervisor runs Tower Sequence Manager; Ramp Control Lead Ramp Movement Board; AOC, Aircraft Operator Rep submit only; SSE technical admin; Data Governance Steward retention/audit review. No single user creates+approves+conceals GDP/AAR/Tactical Regulation Proposal changes; RFP records initiator, approver, object, time. Emergency access: Emergency Response Coordinator, ADM, SSE; Silverpine needs IAS incident ref+expiry; prominent audit, post-review by Steward+operational authority. Audit Event Ledger: auth, privileges, approvals, config, exports, emergency access, slot compliance events(date, flight, airport, runway direction, regulation ref), Time Synchronization Service time source; Warehouse can't alter. Compliance compares CTT, TOBT, AOBT, ATOT vs tolerance; Slot Compliance State: compliant/early/late/exempted/substituted/cancelled/pending review. Airport CDM Portal decisions linked to IAS role. CDL keeps reason, time, flight, context. Substitution records: original/replacement flight, CTT, acceptance,

New part:
S800: Changes made inside the freeze horizon shall require a reason code and shall be visible to the Regional Flow Manager during post-operations review.
S801: The Tower Sequence Manager and Ramp Movement Board shall provide actual movement milestones that support independent verification of slot performance.
S802: Surface movement evidence from the Surface Surveillance Adapter shall be retained long enough to support dispute resolution and regulatory audit requests.
S803: Capacity changes made through the Capacity Assessment Module shall be correlated with the active Airport Capacity Plan and Airport Acceptance Rate used at the time of allocation.
S804: The Performance Analytics Warehouse shall aggregate compliance outcomes by carrier, route group, regulation, airport operating configuration, and time band.
S805: Aggregated metrics shall support review of systemic lateness without exposing commercially sensitive detail beyond authorized roles.
S806: The Data Governance Steward shall verify that audit fields required for slot performance reporting remain complete, immutable, and traceable to approved data definitions.
S807: The System Support Engineer shall investigate technical gaps when audit sequences show missing events, duplicate updates, or inconsistent timestamps.
S808: The Regional Flow Manager shall use the Post Operations Report to identify whether noncompliance resulted from operator choice, airport constraint, airspace constraint, weather impact, or system issue.
S809: The Airport Duty Manager shall review late airport-driven changes that affected multiple flights and shall record whether the operational justification was valid.
S810: Findings from the review shall feed adjustments to tolerance values, reason code definitions, and training material, subject to change control.
S811: All audit outputs shall be retained according to the approved records schedule and shall remain searchable for compliance investigations, performance meetings, and lessons-learned activity.
S812: Data governance for the Regional Flow Platform shall assign accountable owners to each operational data domain and shall make those assignments visible in the Airport CDM Portal.
S813: The Data Governance Steward shall maintain the data ownership register and shall coordinate updates through the Business Rules Registry.
S814: The Regional Flow Manager shall own flow management policy data, including Ground Delay Program parameters and Tactical Regulation Proposal status values.
S815: The Slot Coordinator shall own slot allocation reference data, including Calculated Takeoff Time tolerances and Slot Compliance State definitions.
S816: The Airport Duty Manager shall own airport capacity declarations, including Airport Capacity Plan records and Airport Acceptance Rate values.
S817: The Tower Supervisor shall own tower sequence status data maintained for the Tower Sequence Manager.
S818: The Ramp Control Lead shall own ramp movement status data maintained for the Ramp Movement Board.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
